title: Examining Bias in Opinion Summarisation Through the Perspective of Opinion Diversity

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a fine-tuned stance detection model (COVID-Stance-BERT) to extract stances (support, against, neutral) from both source documents and generated summaries, then computing opinion diversity (via F1 scores comparing the sets of stances) and opinion similarity (via cosine similarity of token representations) to evaluate whether the summarization models fairly cover the diverse viewpoints present in the source texts.
